observed_self_organized_exchanges.title: PARK_SHARED_EMPLOYEE_GROUP
observed_self_organized_exchanges.current_bridge: 工会/园区人员收集企业阶段性用工需求与职工可用时间，在微信群中人工撮合，并配套培训、沟通和权益保障。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.real_exchange_evidence: 宁波园区共享员工群覆盖62家企业、376名职工，已实现数百人次共享调配；企业旺季补岗和职工淡季增收均有真实交换。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.commercial_read: 真实交换成立，但价值依赖持续的人力供给、岗位匹配、劳动合规和履约管理；2026年腾讯地图等平台已经把临时招工、打卡、薪资结算产品化。

observed_self_organized_exchanges.title: PAID_DAZI_GROUPS_AND_AA_ORGANIZERS
observed_self_organized_exchanges.current_bridge: 个人主理人在短视频/社交平台引流进微信群，收取小额入群费，组织活动、AA、商家合作和群内匹配。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.real_exchange_evidence: 2026年报道显示同城搭子群已形成收费和商家导流模式，群主收9.9—39.9元入群费，线下活动通常AA。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.commercial_read: 真实付费成立，但核心资产是持续流量、社群氛围和线下组织；活动报名、AA、群管理和同城匹配工具已经成熟，剩余价值高度依赖人工运营。

observed_self_organized_exchanges.title: SURPLUS_MEAL_WECHAT_GROUP
observed_self_organized_exchanges.chinese_title: 余量餐微信群低价流转
observed_self_organized_exchanges.current_bridge: 餐饮商户把当日合规余量餐通过微信群提前发布，社区或取餐点连接错峰用餐人群，线下取餐。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.real_exchange_evidence: 2026年浙江松阳已有社区+商户用微信群每天公布余量餐，以低价有偿方式服务外卖骑手等群体。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.commercial_read: 供需真实，但惜食魔法袋已覆盖300多个城市和大量商户；食品安全、时效、线下取货也要求本地运营，不是轻软件微边。

observed_self_organized_exchanges.title: LOGISTICS_PARK_CAPACITY_ALLIANCE
observed_self_organized_exchanges.chinese_title: 物流园运力与仓储共享联盟
observed_self_organized_exchanges.current_bridge: 园区企业通过自发联盟共享运力、仓储和企业资源，由园区/联盟人工协调需求、金融和合作关系。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.real_exchange_evidence: 2026年长沙雨花物流园企业自愿加入联盟，共享运力并盘活大规模仓储资源。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.commercial_read: 资源价值高，但动作依赖真实仓库、车辆、合同、现场调度和本地企业关系；联盟/园区本身已成为控制节点，独立薄软件容易退化成线索平台。

observed_self_organized_exchanges.title: INDUSTRIAL_PARK_SUPPLY_DEMAND_BULLETIN
observed_self_organized_exchanges.chinese_title: 工业园企业供需公告撮合
observed_self_organized_exchanges.current_bridge: 园区通过公众号、表单/KDocs收集企业采购、销售、服务外包和产能合作需求，公开联系人后由企业直接人工对接。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.real_exchange_evidence: 2026年上海青浦工业园官方上线企业上下游供需合作专栏，要求企业提交规格、数量、预算、交付和联系方式。
observed_self_organized_exchanges.commercial_read: 机器化匹配很容易想象，但缺口本质上是B2B线索发现；交易、验厂、合同、履约仍由企业自行完成，且园区已经免费提供发布入口。

examined_formations.title: SHARED_EMPLOYEE_MATCHING_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Self-organized groups prove demand, but value depends on recurring worker supply, qualification, scheduling, labor compliance and settlement. Current flexible-labor platforms and Tencent Maps already productize nearby job posting, attendance and pay settlement.

examined_formations.title: DAZI_GROUP_OPERATING_SYSTEM
examined_formations.chinese_title: 搭子社群主理人运营系统
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Paid groups and AA activities are real, but signup/payment/AA/reminders are already standard WeChat mini-program capabilities; the scarce part is continued traffic, moderation and offline organization.

examined_formations.title: SURPLUS_MEAL_GROUP_ROUTER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The self-organized flow is real, but established surplus-food platforms already connect merchants and users at scale; food safety, timing and pickup are physical local operations.

examined_formations.title: PARK_LOGISTICS_SHARED_CAPACITY_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Park alliances already coordinate shared transport/warehouse resources. The remaining work is local relationship, contract and physical scheduling/fulfillment rather than a reusable founder-independent software edge.

examined_formations.title: PARK_SUPPLY_DEMAND_AUTOMATCH
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Industrial parks already collect structured purchase/sale requirements and expose direct contacts. Automating text matching does not create transaction rights, proprietary outcomes or a compounding operator asset.
